item.title: CVE-2026-134068 - Stack-based buffer overflow in replication origin name parsing in AWS pgactive
item.description: [Cloud] AWS Security: Bulletin ID: 2026-198-AWS Publication Date: 11/24/2026 10:00 AM PST Description: pgactive is an open source PostgreSQL extension from AWS that provides active-active replication between PostgreSQL databases. We identified CVE-2026-134068, an issue in the replication origin name parsing component of pgactive.
